# Reviewed outbound endpoints for the Keel Dock source-bearing jobs.
#
# Format: one entry per line, "<scope> <pattern>  # reason". The reason is required.
#   scope    all, or one runner family: linux, macos, windows
#   pattern  an exact host name; a leading "*." matches one or more labels (subdomains only,
#            never the suffix itself); any other "*" matches characters within one label.
#            Wildcards are kept to operator-owned names: a wildcard on a platform where anyone
#            can create a name (CDNs, cloud storage) would publish a customer's resource name.
#
# The egress-audit composite publishes a queried host name only when it matches an entry here.
# Every other name is published as a count and a truncated SHA-256, so internal, customer or
# exfiltration-shaped names never reach a public log. An entry is therefore a decision that the
# name is safe to appear in a public log.
#
# Checked by .github/policy/check-egress-allowlist.sh.
#
# Evidence: ported on 2026-10-05 from the Moh-Bakr/Taurine-CI allow-list (the `all` and
# `keeldock` entries that a Keel Dock run reaches; Taurine-only Rust, Android, Playwright and
# live-proof entries were left out), whose Keel Dock evidence is Taurine-CI run 37303687180
# against keeldock-cloud main. Re-check against the first runs of this repository.

# --- GitHub and the Actions runner service -------------------------------------------
all github.com                                  # public and private checkouts, release downloads
all api.github.com                              # token mint, identity and SHA checks, revoke
all codeload.github.com                         # archive downloads of pinned releases
all *.githubusercontent.com                     # release assets, raw files, container bottles
all *.actions.githubusercontent.com             # runner service: logs, results, cache API
all githubapp.com                               # runner service apex
all *.githubapp.com                             # hosted compute orchestrator and watchdog
all ghcr.io                                     # GitHub container registry (Homebrew bottles)
all productionresultssa*.blob.core.windows.net  # Actions results storage (logs, summaries)
all *.github.com                                # GitHub service subdomains (glb-*, uploads, pipelines)
all blob.*.trafficmanager.net                   # Azure storage stamps behind the results storage (two labels deep: Microsoft's, not a customer profile)

# --- CDN names returned as CNAME targets of the hosts below (exact names only) ------------

all azurefd-critical-t-prod-stage2.trafficmanager.net  # packages.microsoft.com CNAME

all mcr.trafficmanager.net                      # mcr.microsoft.com CNAME
all mcr-0001.mcr-msedge.net                     # mcr.microsoft.com CNAME target
all homebrew.github.io                          # formulae.brew.sh CNAME (exact: github.io is user-creatable)
